title: 民间借贷司法文书数据审计 第三轮补充登记
scope: Independent addendum; prior report/registry Library version1 unchanged
source_byte_policy: Counts from actual downloaded original bytes. LFS pointer byte size distinguished from payload. No generated cases, no reconstructed dataset used as original.
privacy_policy: No original cases or quarantined PDFs included; no concealed content recovery; only hashes, aggregate results and safe source identifiers.

datasets.official_name: AppealCase: A Dataset and Benchmark for Civil Case Appeal Scenarios
datasets.text_origin: Authors: China Judgments Online; observed six structural text sections per instance, including header with docket
datasets.transformation_history: Authors describe keyword/rule segmentation and exclusion of unsegmentable documents; privacy removal described. No model-generated input prose or randomized name substitution stated in checked methods, but original-site byte/text equivalence not certified. Published sections lack original separators/offsets.
datasets.native_case_id_status: Official metadata provides native docket strings for both instances; 2616 unique docket strings in second-side loan subset, all located in corresponding headers after whitespace/bracket normalization. This is internal cross-file verification, not external court authentication.
datasets.annotation_origin: Rules/regex plus LLM consensus, manual review for inconsistent outputs; paper reports expert audit of 500 random cases. Not all labels independently human annotated.
datasets.annotation_coverage: Outcome/claims metadata; no exhaustive entity/relation/event/attribution labels
datasets.span_status: No native character spans. Can add offsets against frozen released section text, with independent attribution annotation.
datasets.split_status: One 10000-pair file; no explicit official train/dev/test split found in Git. Must group connected docket families before creating a graph extraction split.
datasets.duplicate_findings: All corpus: 9918 unique first-instance dockets and text strings, 10000 second-instance; 32 repeated first-docket groups, each identical text. Loan second-cause subset has 1308 unique first and 1308 unique second dockets/texts. Near duplicates and cross-corpus overlap not audited.
datasets.license_scope_status: README dataset section explicitly CC BY-NC 4.0; linked author HF metadata agrees. Not commercial/enterprise-production clearance. Do not conflate paper CC BY-NC-SA with dataset license.
datasets.recommended_use: Highest-priority new main-source candidate: strict paired-loan pilot and human graph annotation, preserve both-instance provenance. Do not freeze replacement before authenticity/segmentation checks.
datasets.admission_status: 已取得文件并固定版本；已完成关键结构审计；适合原文候选，需原站映射/分段核验及人工补标
open_questions: Original-site or trusted archival text equivalence and privacy transformations
Section missegmentation and attribution within fact_description
Near duplicates, cross-dataset duplication, linked proceeding families
Project use fits noncommercial license
datasets.next_action: Freeze independent pilot from strict 1258-pair intersection; verify docket-based originals and section boundaries, then annotate entities/events/claims with section offsets and family-aware split. Stop upgrade if original mapping or allowed use cannot be established.
datasets.native_gold_status: Not certified as exhaustive graph gold
datasets.human_audit_status: Automated structure/equality audit plus limited source-method inspection; no gold reannotation completed

datasets.official_name: ClaimGen-CN: A Large-scale Chinese Dataset for Legal Claim Generation
datasets.record_unit: plaintiff facts/reasons segment + plaintiff claim(s), not full judgment
datasets.text_origin: Authors: first-instance civil judgments from China Judgments Online; task-selected plaintiff facts and claims sections
datasets.transformation_history: Rule/keyword document segmentation and selection; only plaintiff facts and claims released. Ethics describes government corpus anonymized where necessary; README says PII removed. No LLM rewriting of input stated in checked methods, but court-original verbatim equivalence and release-specific anonymization not verified.
datasets.native_case_id_status: Only local integer id; all 1000 test IDs overlap full dataset with different fact strings, so namespace by file/version.
datasets.annotation_origin: Original plaintiff claims paired with factual segment; 1000-case test selected for fully court-supported claims. Not entity/relation/event annotations.
datasets.annotation_coverage: Plaintiff side only; claims are allegations/demands, not automatically court-established facts
datasets.span_status: No offsets or full judgment mapping
datasets.split_status: Full file plus test file, not safe disjoint train/test. 512 exact facts shared full/test, including 84 private-lending fact strings.
datasets.duplicate_findings: 45394 loan records have 45394 distinct fact strings; exact distinctness is not distinct judicial-case proof. Test IDs cannot identify cases globally.
datasets.license_scope_status: Dataset README CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, restricted to noncommercial academic research. HF card has no license field; use Git evidence.
datasets.recommended_use: Large plaintiff-claim/attribution supplementary corpus, not replacement for complete judgment source
datasets.admission_status: 已取得文件并固定版本；已完成结构审计；适合原告诉称片段候选
open_questions: Original full-document/docket mapping
Precise privacy transformation
Case-family/near duplicate overlap
datasets.next_action: Use only separately selected non-test pilot; do not count 45394 records as certified distinct cases or use allegations as findings.

datasets.transformation_history: Section extraction, precise input cleaning not verified. Relevance output strings not guaranteed verbatim.
datasets.native_case_id_status: Local numeric-string keys only; 21 texts contain docket-like strings, not certified own-case metadata.
datasets.annotation_origin: Paper abstract explicitly GPT-4 relevant sentence labels; do not call human gold
datasets.annotation_coverage: Question-specific relevance, not exhaustive entity/relation/event labels
datasets.span_status: No offsets. One 48-question sample: 47 nonempty sentence outputs, 7 exact full-string substrings; newline split gives 152/175 exact substrings. Nonmatches include punctuation changes and possibly rewriting; no universal error claim.
datasets.split_status: No explicit split found; 100 documents and per-ID annotations
datasets.duplicate_findings: 100 distinct case text strings; no family split audit
datasets.license_scope_status: No LICENSE in complete Git tree. Paper publication license is not data license.
datasets.recommended_use: Question schema and model-label diagnostic reference; optional small raw-section pilot only after source and use verification

datasets.official_name: 最高人民法院国际商事法庭：法律查明案例库 / 裁判文书
datasets.version_or_commit: 2026-10-02 retrieval snapshot; mutable institutional pages, no release/commit
datasets.record_unit: Downloaded judgment-form HTML article; one appellate judgment
datasets.private_lending_selection_rule: Official article title identifies 民间借贷; substantive court finding separately reviewed
datasets.text_origin: Official CICC HTML publication; its source label says 中国裁判文书网
datasets.transformation_history: Upstream word-processing-to-HTML formatting visible. Independent comparison with China Judgments original was not attempted. Offline view extracts HTML paragraph text, preserves characters, inserts LF paragraph separators; raw HTML retained.
datasets.native_case_id_status: （2021）粤01民终2980号; referenced first-instance case （2020）粤0191民初16181号
datasets.duplicate_findings: Search surfaces the same article ID 12890 under both /333/ and /428/434/ routes. Treat as route aliases, not two cases. No cross-corpus duplicate test performed.
datasets.license_scope_status: Site footer reserves copyright. Raw HTML contains a hidden disclaimer attribute limiting legal resources to study/research and disclaiming completeness/accuracy/currentness. This is not an explicit dataset or redistribution license; scope applicability remains unresolved.
datasets.recommended_use: Authentic, traceable boundary/attribution pilot; not an ordinary-loan positive. Appeals court characterizes transaction as Macau gaming credit and reverses first-instance result.
datasets.admission_status: Downloaded, hash-fixed, structurally audited; provisional raw-source candidate pending provenance/licensing and human annotation
open_questions: Can additional ordinary-loan cases be downloaded reliably without redirects?
Is official HTML word-for-word equal to originally published judgment?
What conditions govern machine extraction, storage, annotation, and redistribution?
datasets.next_action: Try the already discovered official 润本公司 12861 or 李野 1414 article only if normal public access resumes; stop on access control, security warning, or repeated redirect failure.
datasets.metrics_basis: This round downloaded-byte structural audit; claims of provenance/annotation origin separately attributed to authors or publisher
datasets.observed_private_lending_count_basis: Article title classification only; appellate court treated transaction as Macau gaming credit; ordinary_loan_positive_count is zero

datasets.official_name: 全国企业破产重整案件信息网：扬州市广陵区广济医院清算组案件公示附件
datasets.version_or_commit: 2026-10-02 retrieval snapshot; mutable institutional pages, no release/commit
datasets.private_lending_selection_rule: Official attachment names plus visually inspected court cover titles and case IDs
datasets.text_origin: Court judgment PDFs posted by named liquidation group on the Supreme People’s Court bankruptcy information platform; publisher is liquidation group, not directly the adjudicating court
datasets.transformation_history: Three original attachment byte streams retained in local quarantine. Two are image-only scans; one has embedded text. Visible masking and embedded text diverge in one PDF. Derived text/previews removed after discovery; no hidden/redacted text recovery or further extraction.
datasets.duplicate_findings: Three different native case IDs, but same defendant and same publishing docket context. Do not assume independent problem families or split randomly across train/test.
datasets.license_scope_status: Public download links and copyright footer only; no dataset-specific license found. Access does not establish permission to redistribute.
datasets.recommended_use: Discovery metadata only. Quarantine all three. No corpus ingestion or publication until a properly privacy-reviewed source and use conditions are available.
datasets.admission_status: Downloaded and hash-fixed; excluded from current ingest pending privacy/licensing review, with OCR barrier for 2/3
open_questions: Is a properly privacy-reviewed text version available?
Are permission terms for research ingestion, derived annotations and redistribution stated anywhere?
Does a non-OCR version exist for the two scanned judgments?
datasets.next_action: Do not extract further or recover concealed text. Prefer a correctly privacy-reviewed official source; otherwise stop investment in these three PDFs.
